title: EU matchmaking DNS postmortem
brief: Postmortem page please, for the Network team at Alder Cloud Games: incident INC-3107, a DNS misconfiguration on 2026-08-19 that broke matchmaking for players in Europe. Tiles at the top: Duration 1 h 52 min, Lowest success rate 61.3 percent, Matches failed 48200, Region EU-West. Section titled "What happened": a paragraph explaining that a Terraform change replaced the weighted DNS records for match.eu with a single record pointing at a decommissioned load balancer, and negative caching with a TTL of 3600 seconds kept failures going after the fix. Section titled "Timeline" as a table with columns Time (UTC), Event: 09:12 Terraform apply; 09:15 success rate drops; 09:31 player reports spike on social media; 09:40 incident declared; 10:05 bad record identified; 10:11 record restored; 11:04 success rate back above 99 percent and incident resolved. Section titled "Request success rate": a line chart of matchmaking success rate percent every 15 minutes: 09:00 99.6, 09:15 84.2, 09:30 63.0, 09:45 61.3, 10:00 62.8, 10:15 70.4, 10:30 81.9, 10:45 93.5, 11:00 98.7, 11:15 99.5. Section titled "Action items": a bulleted list: require a plan review for DNS changes, lower the negative cache TTL to 300 seconds, add synthetic matchmaking checks from three EU cities.

edit.request: Add 11:30 at 99.7 percent to the chart, and add an action item "Alert when weighted record count drops to one".
expect_visible: Alert when weighted record count drops to one
